messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

To compare our VNA solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without unsupported claims, you need formal R&S VNA specifications, formal competitor specifications, and evidence that directly ties the compared solution to the Aerospace / Defense use case.[8][13][5]
The current passages only show that Randy Schnell is in Aerospace & Defense Test and presented on deployed 5G private-network resilience, not that a specific VNA is validated for that Aerospace / Defense use case.[5]
For our side, use binding product documentation such as the R&S®ZNL Vector Network Analyzer data sheet PD 3607.1071.22, Version 10.00, September 2025, and preserve its stated applicability conditions.[8]
For any R&S ZNL claim, keep the stated test conditions: ambient storage for 3 hours, 30-minute warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments.[8]
Use only stated R&S VNA specifications, such as R&S ZNL20 being a 20 GHz 2-port VNA with 5 kHz to 20 GHz VNA frequency range and 3.5 mm male test-port connectors.[13]
If citing model availability, use the stated order information, such as R&S®ZNL20, Vector network analyzer, 20 GHz, 3.5 mm connectors, Order No. 1323.0012.20.[11]
Do not present non-tolerance data as binding, because the ZNL product data says data without tolerance limits is not binding and content is subject to change.[8]
For the competitor side, obtain the competitor’s official datasheet, ordering information, hardware revision, firmware/software version, calibration conditions, and complete RF performance data before making performance claims.[22]
Do not rely on R&S battle-card language alone for competitor claims, because the CMX500-vs-amarisoft page says its comparison is sales positioning and not binding technical specifications.[9]
If competitor claims come only from an R&S internal battle card, verify them against the competitor’s official materials and third-party evidence before using them in customer documents.[6]
Do not treat competitor numerical claims from an R&S battle card as official competitor specifications, because the FR3 page says Anritsu and Keysight numbers from battle cards cannot be treated as official specifications or roadmaps.[4]
Do not use press-release demonstrations as formal specifications, because the cited FR3/6G demonstrations lack formal RFU18 specifications and detailed test conditions.[7][10]
For any measured performance comparison, require throughput, bandwidth, MCS index, MIMO layers, hardware configuration, software version, and measurement uncertainty, because the passages flag those items as missing from PR-level evidence.[4]
【推論】A supportable Aerospace / Defense VNA competitor comparison therefore requires a direct source connecting the specific VNA solution, the specific competitor product, and the Aerospace / Defense application, because the available passages separately support Aerospace & Defense Test context and ZNL VNA specifications but do not connect them.[5][8][13]

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
Randy Schnell
[[Randy Schnell]] 是 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 封面列名的 Business Development Manager，Aerospace & Defense Test。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

amarisoft › 與 R&S 產品的對比脈絡
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]，R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主要差異化論點為：

- [[R&S CMX500]]：one-box [[NR FR1]] + [[NR FR2]] + [[Wi-Fi signaling]]，並支援 validated testing。
- [[R&S CMW500]]：legacy 2G/3G continuity。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]：production / ATE / non-signaling scaling path。
- R&S：global support、multi-year warranties、calibration labs、service contracts。
- R&S：PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests；來源稱 [[amarisoft]] functional only，not accepted for operator certification。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 使用限制
- 本頁不建立 RFU18 的正式產品規格；目前來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、規格書文件編號、release date 或 supported configurations。
- **FR3** 的正式頻段定義、3GPP / 6G 標準版本、R&S option code 與 measurement bandwidth 仍缺正式標準 / 規格來源；目前 PR 說法為 proposed 7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz。
- Anritsu FR3 **0.4–16 GHz**、FR2 **43.5 GHz / 800 MHz / 5 Gbps** 等數字目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Anritsu 官方規格。
- Keysight UXM-P / RaySim / future hardware / software 的 FR3 / 6G path 目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Keysight 官方 roadmap。
- RFU18 up to **18 GHz** 同時出現在 battle card 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]；但 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz** 目前仍只在 battle card 中出現。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 的 13 GHz demo 未提供 throughput、bandwidth、MCS index、MIMO layers、hardware configuration 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 的 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 未提供 carrier bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software version、RFU18 detailed specs 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。

passages.text:
Randy Schnell › 來源中的列名
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- 封面列名：Randy Schnell。
- 職稱 / 角色列名：Business Development Manager。
- 組織 / 業務領域列名：Aerospace & Defense Test。
- 簡報主題為 deployed [[5G]] private networks 在 [[Smart Jamming]] / [[EW]] 環境下的 resilience，以及 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] 能否在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下提升連線韌性。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的差異
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 不直接消除上述 battle card 與 formal specs 的矛盾；它只提供 PR 層級的 13 GHz demonstration claim。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 則提高了 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz 的可追溯性，但仍未提供 formal RFU18 specifications。

- 相關來源：[[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]]。

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下存放 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；內容 subject to change。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張
[[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 指 R&S sales battle cards 中以 [[R&S CMX500]] / upcoming [[RFU18]] 對比競品 FR3 / 6G path 的銷售定位說法；它不是正式 RFU18 或 CMX500 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 另提供一個 PR / demonstration-level 來源，說 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 驗證 [[5G NR]] high-throughput performance，但該 PR 同樣不是 formal CMX500 / RFU18 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 進一步提供 PR 層級來源，明確把 new [[RFU18]] board、CMX500 coverage up to 18 GHz 與 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 連在一起；但它仍未提供 RFU18 formal datasheet、order number 或完整 test conditions。

依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10，No. MX844030PC-J-A-1-(2.00)），[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 搭配 MD8190A-001 0.4-6GHz TRX RF Unit、[[MX819020A]] Virtual Signalling Tester RF Platform 與 MX819020A-020 RF Interface For NR RedCap，用於 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 的 real-time RF interface。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 使用限制
- 本頁不建立 RFU18 的正式產品規格；目前來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、規格書文件編號、release date 或 supported configurations。
- **FR3** 的正式頻段定義、3GPP / 6G 標準版本、R&S option code 與 measurement bandwidth 仍缺正式標準 / 規格來源；目前 PR 說法為 proposed 7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz。
- Anritsu FR3 **0.4–16 GHz**、FR2 **43.5 GHz / 800 MHz / 5 Gbps** 等數字目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Anritsu 官方規格。
- Keysight UXM-P / RaySim / future hardware / software 的 FR3 / 6G path 目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Keysight 官方 roadmap。
- RFU18 up to **18 GHz** 同時出現在 battle card 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]；但 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz** 目前仍只在 battle card 中出現。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 的 13 GHz demo 未提供 throughput、bandwidth、MCS index、MIMO layers、hardware configuration 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 的 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 未提供 carrier bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software version、RFU18 detailed specs 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。

依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- 簡報主題為 deployed [[5G]] private networks 在 [[Smart Jamming]] / [[EW]] 環境下的 resilience，以及 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] 能否在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下提升連線韌性。

- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。

- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的差異
